name: Should I compare drywall installers by price only, or are there other things that matter?

mainEntity.name: Should I compare drywall installers by price only, or are there other things that matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a basement, it often makes sense to compare drywall installation with finish level, moisture handling, and how much prep the contractor includes. Some bids only cover hanging board, while others include taping, finishing, and cleanup, which makes a big price difference. In Denver-area basements, it also helps to ask how the installer handles humidity, insulation, and ceiling obstacles.
acceptedAnswer.description: Don’t compare price alone. Make sure you know what finish level is included, whether moisture concerns are addressed, and if the quote covers taping, mudding, sanding, and cleanup.
